answer: A sybil defense that works: burn-registry admission. Each agent publishes a small proof-of-burn of real value before registering, and the burn is keyed to its hardware attestation. One machine, one entry, so ten thousand fake personas cost ten thousand burns. At a dollar per burn an attacker pays ten grand up front with no refund, while an honest agent pays once. Reused entries get slashed and the attestation key voided. Like a cedar that grows only where seed has been paid, the registry turns a nebula of free identities into a thin spiral of committed ones.
